basis: Each actual original PNG opened once at original resolution before any redraw. This is author inventory, not independent source or science review.

sourcePixelFacts.projection: Three nested slightly oblique, near-circular dashed profiles sharing the ray intersection. They depict the concentric spherical surfaces stated by the frozen modern prose; the PNG does not show a separately identifiable latitude/meridian ellipse family.
sourcePixelFacts.spacing: Unequal apparent shell gaps: the outer gap is much larger than the inner gap. No equal-spacing claim or scale is printed.
sourcePixelFacts.relationships: All eight solid rays share one center, cross all three nested profiles, and point away from it. Opposite rays form four diameter directions.

modernAdditions: An open center disk and a plus glyph clarify the positive point-charge example explicitly stated by the frozen prose; neither is claimed as a printed source glyph.
One muted dashed projected meridian per shell makes the spherical reading explicit. These three added projection curves are not claimed as source-visible meridians or additional equipotential levels.
Smooth uncalibrated profiles, larger glyphs and strokes, and modest layout centering. Preserve the three source shell levels and unequal gaps; do not label or equate their radii.

arrowheads.direction: All arrows leave the positive right charge and approach the negative left charge. Connecting curves and the intercharge axis point right-to-left; exterior axis arrows point leftward on the left and rightward on the right.

sourcePixelFacts.unitsOrNumericCalibration: No unit, charge magnitude, distance, or voltage scale is printed. Preserve the visible level glyphs, without inventing negative labels, volts, equal potential increments or calibrated dimensions.
sourcePixelFacts.sphericalProjectionOrMeridians: This is the dipole field/equipotential section. No separate sphere silhouette, meridian lattice, shaded solid, grid or axis ticks are visible.
sourcePixelFacts.relationships: The two equal-sized charge disks share the horizontal axis. Solid field lines and dashed equipotential contours remain distinct. Five nested dashed contours surround each charge without touching the opposite charge; the dashed zero line is midway between the charges. Field curves cross equipotentials transversely, with the regular electrostatic normal relationship required by the frozen prose.

modernAdditions: Deterministic smooth uncalibrated curves representing the retained source families. Internal dimensionless construction parameters are not printed measurements or inferred source values.

The eleven original level glyphs are enlarged and separated. Ten thin muted reference leaders bind the relocated nonzero glyphs to their corresponding dashed contours; these leaders are not field lines, equipotential levels or source data.
The charge disks and signs remain minus-left/plus-right. No new field label, equation, potential unit, answer, measurement or polarity claim is added.
